validations.expression: has(object.spec.provider) && object.spec.provider == 'generic' && has(object.spec.suspend) && object.spec.suspend == false && has(object.spec.recurseSubmodules) && object.spec.recurseSubmodules == false
validations.message: Provider, suspension, and submodule settings must remain canonical.
The qualification source name and protected-main commit must match.
Tag, SemVer, and arbitrary named refs are forbidden.
Secret, proxy, verification, include, and sparse-checkout inputs are forbidden.
Noncanonical source identity and ignore fields are forbidden.
Qualification source metadata must remain canonical.
Release sources are create-once; only controller metadata and status may change.
Qualification inputs must use a full-commit release name.

validations.expression:

  object.data.API_IMAGE.matches(
    '^us-central1-docker[.]pkg[.]dev/${GCP_PROJECT_ID}/meshr/api@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$') &&
  object.data.EVENT_PLANE_IMAGE.matches(
    '^us-central1-docker[.]pkg[.]dev/${GCP_PROJECT_ID}/meshr/event-plane@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$') &&
  object.data.MODERATION_ADAPTER_IMAGE.matches(
    '^us-central1-docker[.]pkg[.]dev/${GCP_PROJECT_ID}/meshr/moderation-adapter@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$') &&

validations.expression:
!object.metadata.name.matches(
  '^meshr-r-[br]-[a-f0-9]{40}-[a-f0-9]{12}$') ||
(object.data.size() == 20 &&
  [
    'GCP_PROJECT_ID',
    'MESHR_FIRESTORE_DATABASE',
    'MESHR_TOPOLOGY_FIRESTORE_DATABASE',
    'MESHR_EVENT_AUDIT_FIRESTORE_DATABASE',
    'MESHR_NOTIFICATIONS_FIRESTORE_DATABASE',
    'MESHR_MODERATION_FIRESTORE_DATABASE',
    'MESHR_EXPECTED_AUTHORITY_BOOTSTRAP_ID',
    'MESHR_FORCE_PROJECTION_BOOTSTRAP_SCAN',
    'MESHR_DATABASE_CUTOVER_MODE',
    'MESHR_CUTOVER_VALIDATION_MESH_ID',
    'MESHR_CUTOVER_VALIDATION_BINDING_ID',
    'MESHR_CUTOVER_VALIDATION_AGENT_ID',
    'MESHR_CUTOVER_VALIDATION_SESSION_ID',
    'MESHR_MODERATION_ENDPOINT',
    'MESHR_MODERATION_HEALTHCHECK_URL',
    'MESHR_MODERATION_AUDIENCE',
    'MESHR_MODERATION_RELEASE_SHA',
    'MESHR_MODERATION_REVISION_TAG',
    'MESHR_RELEASE_SHA',
    'MESHR_COST_PROTECTION_MODE'
  ].all(key, key in object.data) &&
  object.data.GCP_PROJECT_ID == '${GCP_PROJECT_ID}' &&
  object.data.MESHR_FIRESTORE_DATABASE == '${MESHR_FIRESTORE_DATABASE}' &&
  object.data.MESHR_TOPOLOGY_FIRESTORE_DATABASE == '${MESHR_TOPOLOGY_FIRESTORE_DATABASE}' &&
  object.data.MESHR_EVENT_AUDIT_FIRESTORE_DATABASE == '${MESHR_EVENT_AUDIT_FIRESTORE_DATABASE}' &&
  object.data.MESHR_NOTIFICATIONS_FIRESTORE_DATABASE == '${MESHR_NOTIFICATIONS_FIRESTORE_DATABASE}' &&
  object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_FIRESTORE_DATABASE == '${MESHR_MODERATION_FIRESTORE_DATABASE}' &&
  [
    object.data.MESHR_EXPECTED_AUTHORITY_BOOTSTRAP_ID,
    object.data.MESHR_CUTOVER_VALIDATION_MESH_ID,
    object.data.MESHR_CUTOVER_VALIDATION_BINDING_ID,
    object.data.MESHR_CUTOVER_VALIDATION_AGENT_ID,
    object.data.MESHR_CUTOVER_VALIDATION_SESSION_ID
  ].all(value, value.matches('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$')) &&
  object.data.MESHR_FORCE_PROJECTION_BOOTSTRAP_SCAN.matches('^[01]$') &&
  object.data.MESHR_DATABASE_CUTOVER_MODE.matches(
    '^(off|normal|validation)$') &&
  object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_AUDIENCE == '${MESHR_MODERATION_AUDIENCE}' &&
  object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_AUDIENCE.matches(
    '^https://[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?([.][a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*[.]run[.]app$') &&
  !object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_AUDIENCE.contains('---') &&
  object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_RELEASE_SHA == object.data.MESHR_RELEASE_SHA &&
  object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_REVISION_TAG.matches('^r-[a-f0-9]{20}$') &&
  object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_RELEASE_SHA.startsWith(
    object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_REVISION_TAG.split('r-')[1]) &&
  object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_REVISION_TAG.size() + 3 +
    object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_AUDIENCE.split('https://')[1].split('.')[0].size() <= 63 &&
  object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_ENDPOINT ==
    'https://' + object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_REVISION_TAG + '---' +
      object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_AUDIENCE.split('https://')[1] + '/screen' &&
  object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_HEALTHCHECK_URL ==
    'https://' + object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_REVISION_TAG + '---' +
      object.data.MESHR_MODERATION_AUDIENCE.split('https://')[1] + '/health' &&
  object.data.MESHR_RELEASE_SHA.matches('^[a-f0-9]{40}$') &&
  object.metadata.name.split('-')[3] == object.data.MESHR_RELEASE_SHA &&
  ((object.metadata.name.split('-')[2] == 'b' &&
      object.data.MESHR_EXPECTED_AUTHORITY_BOOTSTRAP_ID == 'pending' &&
      object.data.MESHR_FORCE_PROJECTION_BOOTSTRAP_SCAN == '1') ||
    (object.metadata.name.split('-')[2] == 'r' &&
      object.data.MESHR_EXPECTED_AUTHORITY_BOOTSTRAP_ID != 'pending' &&
      object.data.MESHR_FORCE_PROJECTION_BOOTSTRAP_SCAN == '0')) &&
  object.data.MESHR_COST_PROTECTION_MODE.matches(
    '^(normal|protect|throttle)$'))

validations.expression:
(request.operation == 'CREATE' &&
  object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].startsWith('b-') &&
  object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/previous-release-id'] ==
    object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'] &&
  object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/transition-kind'] == 'bootstrap') ||
(request.userInfo.username == 'system:serviceaccount:flux-system:kustomize-controller' &&
  object.spec == oldObject.spec &&
  object.metadata.annotations == oldObject.metadata.annotations) ||
(request.userInfo.username == '${CONNECT_GATEWAY_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL}' &&
  object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'] !=
    oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'] &&
  (
    (object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'] ==
        oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/previous-release-id'] &&
      object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].startsWith('r-') &&
      object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/previous-release-id'] ==
        oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'] &&
      oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/transition-kind'] == 'forward' &&
      object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/transition-kind'] == 'rollback') ||
    (object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].split('-')[1] !=
        oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].split('-')[1] &&
      oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].startsWith('r-') &&
      object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].startsWith('r-') &&
      has(oldObject.status) &&
      has(oldObject.status.observedGeneration) &&
      oldObject.status.observedGeneration == oldObject.metadata.generation &&
      has(oldObject.status.conditions) &&
      oldObject.status.conditions.exists(condition,
        condition.type == 'Ready' &&
        condition.status == 'True' &&
        has(condition.observedGeneration) &&
        condition.observedGeneration == oldObject.metadata.generation) &&
      has(oldObject.status.lastAppliedRevision) &&
      oldObject.status.lastAppliedRevision ==
        'main@sha1:' +
          oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].split('-')[1] &&
      object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/previous-release-id'] ==
        oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'] &&
      object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/transition-kind'] == 'forward' &&
      (oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/transition-kind'] != 'rollback' ||
        object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].split('-')[1] !=
          oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/previous-release-id'].split('-')[1])) ||
    (object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].split('-')[1] ==
        oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].split('-')[1] &&
      oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].startsWith('b-') &&
      object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/active-release-id'].startsWith('r-') &&
      object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/previous-release-id'] ==
        oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/previous-release-id'] &&
      oldObject.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/transition-kind'] == 'bootstrap' &&
      object.metadata.annotations['meshr.social/transition-kind'] == 'bootstrap')
  ) &&
  ((!has(object.metadata.labels) && !has(oldObject.metadata.labels)) ||
    (has(object.metadata.labels) && has(oldObject.metadata.labels) &&
      object.metadata.labels == oldObject.metadata.labels)) &&
  ((!has(object.metadata.ownerReferences) && !has(oldObject.metadata.ownerReferences)) ||
    (has(object.metadata.ownerReferences) && has(oldObject.metadata.ownerReferences) &&
      object.metadata.ownerReferences == oldObject.metadata.ownerReferences)) &&
  ((!has(object.metadata.finalizers) && !has(oldObject.metadata.finalizers)) ||
    (has(object.metadata.finalizers) && has(oldObject.metadata.finalizers) &&
      object.metadata.finalizers == oldObject.metadata.finalizers)))
